title: Bus deserts: the villages with no bus and the last bus home
excerpt: I counted every timetabled bus in England on a Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday and checked every village. 41% have no stop with four or more weekday buses within 800 metres, 62% have no bus after seven in the evening and 68% have none on Sunday.
seo_description: 41% of English villages have no usable weekday bus within 800 m and 68% no Sunday bus. Every stop and village mapped.
